model: Frozen mask_plain checkpoints from joint_imputation_pfn, all three seeds. These were continued-trained with zero values + original mask and query CE. Every arm uses exactly the same checkpoint. The existing common numeric/mask/token-control interface is reused, without extra updates. Candidate completions enter through its finite-value path; native_nan retains NaNs at encoder_x in this common interface, not the full official preprocessing pipeline.
feature_law: Independent feature channels conditional on one shared graph regime rho. Symmetric normalized adjacency S has no self loops; R_rho=(I-rho*S)^(-1), rescaled to unit diagonal. K_rho=0.5*11^T+0.5*R_rho. Equal prior over four rho values. Observed RMS-scaled values determine exact Gaussian conditional means/covariances and the regime posterior under this surrogate law. Padded constant feature is excluded from evidence and sampling. This is not the official SCM feature posterior.
contrast: joint_samples and diagonal_samples use identical regime draws and standard normal draws; diagonal_samples retains conditional mean and every conditional variance but removes off-diagonal covariance within each regime. The regime remains graph-shared in both. posterior_mean inserts the posterior mixture mean. All methods use four identical feature-position RNG seeds and arithmetic probability averaging, so point controls get the same number of PFN forwards.
primary: Joint samples must beat posterior mean, diagonal samples, zero and PCFI ensembles in paired graph NLL on both uniform and clustered groups (average of 90/99.5 rates), with all paired 95% CI upper limits below zero. Also compare native-NaN encoder and simple context/uniform priors; report accuracy and Brier. No promotion of k1/full after inspection.
uncertainty: 5000 graph-paired bootstrap draws after averaging rates/checkpoint seeds per graph. Checkpoint seeds and completion RNG schedule held fixed; no multiplicity correction. Finite four-sample Monte Carlo is part of this implementation.
scope: An actual frozen-inference candidate and source-preservation kill test, not a trained PFN method or a novelty claim. Fresh synthetic graph bank from the same size-restricted official prior; not real graphs/unseen semantic schemas. No labels_query or hidden feature values enter completion or model forward. A failed frozen replacement does not rule out a jointly trained feature distribution. No target-label tuning of covariance/scale/grid/samples/stopping. No automatic extra loss or training rescue.
